name: Cetitan
description: Cetitan, the Terra Whale Pokémon, and the evolved form of Cetoddle. An Ice type.
pokedex_entries: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.
Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.
